title: Pumpkin-MC/Pumpkin
description: Empowering everyone to host fast and efficient Minecraft servers. Pumpkin Pumpkin is a Minecraft server built entirely in Rust, offering a fast, efficient, and customizable experience. It prioritizes performance and player enjoyment while adhering to the core mechanics of the game. Goals Performance: Leveraging multi-threading for maximum speed and efficiency. Compatibility: Supports the latest Java & Bedrock Minecraft server version while adhering to Vanilla game mechanics. Security: Prioritizes security by preventing known security exploits. Flexibility: Highly configurable, with the ability to disable unnecessary features. Extensibility: Provides a foundation for plugin development. Important Pumpkin is currently under heavy development. tldr: Pumpkin-MC/Pumpkin 是一个用 Rust 语言编写的 Minecraft 服务器，主打高性能、多线程并发和高度可定制化，目前处于重度开发阶段，已支持 Java 版和基岩版（开发中）的核心协议功能。
objective_summary: 开源项目 Pumpkin-MC/Pumpkin 正在开发一个完全用 Rust 构建的 Minecraft 服务器。该项目通过多线程架构最大化运行速度和效率，兼容最新 Java 版和基岩版 Minecraft 协议，同时遵循原版游戏机制。项目当前处于重度开发阶段，已实现加密、压缩、世界加载、区块生成、玩家移动与战斗等核心功能，插件开发框架和代理支持（Bungeecord/Velocity）也在路线图中。
key_logic_flow: Pumpkin 是一个完全用 Rust 语言编写的 Minecraft 服务器实现，目标是提供快速、高效且可定制的服务端体验。
项目采用多线程架构以最大化运行速度和效率，并优先防范已知的安全漏洞。
Pumpkin 兼容最新的 Java 版和 Bedrock 版 Minecraft 协议，同时遵循原版游戏机制。
当前已实现的协议功能包括加密、数据包压缩、服务器状态查询、皮肤加载、传送、移动、背包、战斗和计分板等。
世界相关功能已支持世界加载与保存、区块加载与生成（三种模式：Vanilla/Linear/Pump）、光照、红石电路和液体物理。
项目处于重度开发阶段，实体 AI、生物生成、成就系统和代理模式（Bungeecord/Velocity）等功能仍在开发中。

Skills Document Processing Development & Code Tools Data & Analysis Business & Marketing Communication & Writing Creative & Media Productivity & Organization Collaboration & Project Management Security & Systems App Automation via Composio Getting Started Creating Skills Contributing Resources License What Are Claude Skills? Claude Skills are reusable instruction packages that teach an AI agent how to handle a specific class of tasks. Each skill is a folder containing a SKILL.md file with YAML frontmatter (name, description) and Markdown instructions, optionally bundled with scripts, references, and assets. Anthropic introduced the format in October 2025 and released it as an open standard in December 2025; it's now supported by Claude Code, Claude.ai, the Claude API, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Antigravity, and Windsurf. Skills load progressively. At session start, the agent sees only each skill's name and description — roughly 100 tokens per skill. The full SKILL.md body (typically under 5,000 tokens) loads only when the agent decides the skill is relevant to the current task. Auxiliary files in scripts/ and references/ load on demand. This is what lets a single agent host hundreds of skills without bloating its context window. Skills are not MCP servers and not tools. MCP defines how an agent connects to external systems — auth, transport, tool discovery. Tools are the individual functions an agent invokes. Skills define the workflow — what to do, in what order, with what guardrails — once the agent has the connections and tools it needs. In production, all three layers run together: MCP for access, tools for actions, skills for behavior. 完全依赖 Cloudflare 免费服务，若 Cloudflare 调整免费额度或服务策略，项目运行成本可能受到影响。
evidence_snippets: 该项目是一个基于 Cloudflare 免费服务构建的完整临时邮箱服务，支持 Rust WASM 邮件解析和 AI 邮件识别功能。
项目使用 Cloudflare Workers、Pages、D1 数据库和 Email Routing 构建后端和前端，前端基于 Vue 3 + Vite + TypeScript。
项目支持 SMTP/IMAP 代理服务、Telegram Bot 集成、用户注册登录和管理后台，并提供社区移动客户端 CloudMail。

object_insights.name: CloudMail
object_insights.positioning: 基于 Expo/React Native 构建的社区移动端管理客户端，为 cloudflare_temp_email 项目提供 Android 管理和邮箱操作能力。
target_users: 需要在移动端管理临时邮箱的普通用户
object_insights.product_signal: 提供 Android 管理员后台、地址管理、收件/发件/未知邮件、验证码快捷复制、OLED 黑主题和本地分组功能，覆盖移动端核心管理场景。
object_insights.differentiation: 作为社区贡献的移动端客户端，填补了 cloudflare_temp_email 项目在移动端管理体验上的空白，是项目生态的重要组成部分。
object_insights.watch_reason: 作为 cloudflare_temp_email 生态中的社区移动客户端，其功能演进和用户反馈能反映项目生态的健康度和社区活跃程度，具有生态观察价值。
risk_notes: 作为社区维护项目，更新节奏和长期维护的可持续性存在不确定性。
功能高度依赖 cloudflare_temp_email 的 API 兼容性，后端接口变更可能导致客户端失效。
evidence_snippets: CloudMail 是基于 Expo / React Native 构建的社区移动端管理客户端，面向 cloudflare_temp_email 项目兼容 API。
CloudMail 提供 Android 管理员后台、地址管理、收件/发件/未知邮件、验证码快捷复制、OLED 黑主题和本地分组功能。
